title: Quietly Flaky Saudi Arabian Mulukhiyah Biryani
description: A jammy, flaky, and cozy Saudi Arabian dish featuring mulukhiyah, shio-cure, and jain-friendly ingredients, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe combines the unique flavors of mulukhiyah with the crunch of shio-cure.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the mulukhiyah leaves and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Add the shio-cure and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the rinsed rice and stir to combine with the mulukhiyah mixture.
Add 4 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let the biryani rest for 5 minutes before serving.
